name: @kitora/auth
description: Kitora's auth and account UI: a framework-free core (adapter contract with a fake, password strength and policy, OTP model, backup codes, TOTP URIs, a QR encoder, sessions, roles and permissions, invites), a browser-behaviour layer (clipboard and file-save adapters), headless React hooks, and styled presets for sign in, sign up, password reset, two-step verification, email verification, account and security settings, roles and members, and creating a workspace (a form on the form engine, a dialog for the sidebar's workspace switcher, a first-run page).

`@kitora/ui`'s `PasswordInput`, compact (13px) and wired to the enclosing `<AuthField>` (label,
hint or error, invalid state), as `AuthInput` is for a text input. The Caps Lock hint is on by
default here, as auth forms always had it; pass `capsLockHint={false}` on a confirm field.
Outside a field, use `PasswordInput` from `@kitora/ui/password-input` directly: auth does not
re-export it, so a bare input can never sit in an `<AuthField>` without its label wiring. For your
own markup, `usePasswordReveal` gives the same behaviour as prop getters.
